title: Render a status badge component from a spec
spec: OBJECTIVE Implement renderBadge in src/badge.js: a small status badge used on the recruiting board to show a count next to a label (e.g. 'Unread 12'). It renders to an HTML string on the server and must be safe against untrusted labels. FILES src/badge.js only. Do not modify tests/. Node built-ins only; no npm packages. INTERFACES export function renderBadge({ label, count = 0, tone = "neutral" }) -> string CONSTRAINTS - Output exactly: {label}{displayCount} - tone is one of neutral, info, success, warning, danger; anything else falls back to neutral. - displayCount: integers 0..99 render as the number; 100 and above render as 99+; negative or non-integer counts render as 0. - label is HTML-escaped (& < > " ') in both the text and the aria-label; a missing or empty label renders as the text Badge. - No trailing whitespace or newlines in the output. VERIFY node --test tests/*.test.mjs REASONING as invoked
